_doc: Second prototype of the formalization review (draft v3.36): three live Mathlib targets through the network's POST /check. Each candidate's provenance and, for planted ones, the defect and the outcome expected. Planted candidates pass if they end outside the main cluster; correct ones if they end in it. 'expect_changed' records a revision after a run, with its reason.

agent-a.author: agent
agent-a.expect_changed: 2026-10-09 after the first run: expected to survive, it was discarded by the domain question at n = 1, correctly. Working blind, the Sonnet formalizer chose 1 ≤ n; the words name no domain, the source (Erdős–Granville–Pomerance–Spiro 1990) takes n ≥ 2, and at n = 1 every σ_k(1) = 1, so its statement is false. A real defect from a blind agent, caught by the review: nothing about it was planted.
